data.title: Michael Saylor Posts “Feeling ₿ullish” 80 Minutes Before BTC USD Drops 5%: Does Strategy’s Chairman Have the Worst Timing on X?
data.description: Strategy chairman Michael Saylor posted “Feeling ₿ullish” on X at 13:08 UTC on Thursday, November 5, with BTC USD at $79,541, and within three hours Bitcoin had fallen to $75,826 as a Wall Street chip-stock crash hit crypto.
